product_metadata.title: Tension Shower Curtain, Spring Shower Tension Curtain Rod, Closet Rod, for Windows or Shower, Rust Resistant Easy to Install, Umimile (Brown, 128-145”)
features: 【Easy to Install】The adjustable shower curtain rod is available from 128 to 145 Inches. If your required length is 128 inches to 145 inches, you can choose this size. It only needs to adjust the length through the adjustment button,so you can quickly and easily install the tension rod without drilling, screws or any tools.

【Multifunction Use】 This tension curtain rod can be used in many areas in your house, perfect for bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, and balcony. This outdoor tension rod can also be used as a room divider curtain rod or a balcony curtain rod.

【Never Rust & Constant Tension】 Never rust under any environment, sturdy and durable. The outdoor curtain rod provides consistent tension, meaning that it always stays reliable and safe, so you don't have to worry about it slipping or falling. Max load 66 lbs. It is recommended that the spring rod not be pulled to its maximum length, and that light to medium weight curtains should be used.

【Apply For All Surface】This outdoor curtain rod can be applied on all surfaces including both of smooth and rough surface like wallpaper, paint wall, tile wall, wooden frame, Etc. Rubber plate will not scratch or damage the installation surface. Remove cleanly.

【Included Product Accessories】One spring rod, two additional long rods（about 42.5 inches), two trimming nuts and two end caps. Note: Due to the improvement of our product, we replaced two short rods with one long rod, so it is possible that you will receive a combination of two short rods and a long rod or a combination of two long rods. The diameter of the rod is about 1.26 inches. The diameter of the end cap is about 2.95 inches.
